About.title: About Me
About.name: Haruka Kikuchi
About.messages:
Haruka is a photographer based between Tokyo and London.

Born in Hawaii and raised in Japan, she has spent the past eight years developing her photographic practice while building a career in digital marketing. In 2026, she relocated to London to further expand her work, studying photography while continuing to photograph people, brands and personal projects.

Her work is driven by storytelling, exploring the relationship between people and the spaces they inhabit. Through gesture, expression, negative space and carefully observed environments, she creates images that feel both cinematic and quietly intimate. Rather than directing every detail, Haruka is interested in capturing the subtle moments that reveal character, atmosphere and emotion.

Alongside editorial, commercial and portrait commissions, she continues to develop long-term documentary and personal projects exploring identity, human connection and contemporary life across cultures.
